تقتفون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَفُونَ (taqtafūna) /taq.ta.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# تُقْتَفَوْنَ (tuqtafawna) /tuq.ta.faw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
